acs.label: ACS 2020-2024 5-year

work.title: Travel Time to Work for Workplace Geography

acs.universe: Workers 16 years and over who did not work from home; every means of transportation; one way.
acs.moe: 90% margin of error; a grouped band's margin is the root of the sum of squared margins (Census Bureau approximation).

router.units: minutes and road miles to one decimal, free-flow driving (no traffic)
router.odbl_notice: Contains information from OpenStreetMap and OpenStreetMap Foundation, made available under the Open Database License.

start_points.colorado: a home town starts at the Census block nearest the job-weighted centre of its home blocks, and a work town ends at the block nearest the centre of its work blocks: LODES 2024 (https://lehd.ces.census.gov/data/lodes/LODES8/co/od/co_od_main_JT01_2024.csv.gz, block points from https://lehd.ces.census.gov/data/lodes/LODES8/co/co_xwalk.csv.gz); a town with no blocks uses its Census Gazetteer internal point (https://www2.census.gov/geo/docs/maps-data/data/gazetteer/2024_Gazetteer/2024_Gaz_place_national.zip)
start_points.town_ends: each town's own ends are in jobs_at and homes_at

meta.detour_rule: drives whose road is over 2.5 times the straight line, with ends 20+ miles apart, are left out
meta.slow_rule: drives of 10+ road miles averaging under 20 mph are left out
